title: pipeline.yaml
description: The only pipeline authoring surface in v0 (SPEC.md §9, ADR-005). Validate the YAML document after decoding it to JSON. Derived from internal/pipeline.Pipeline, which decodes with KnownFields(true) — hence additionalProperties: false.

not.description: `waterfall:` is reserved syntax: the parser MUST accept the key and reject it with 'not implemented in v0' (SPEC.md §9), so a document carrying it is not a valid v0 pipeline.

version.description: Format version. Defaults to 1 when omitted; v0 understands only 1.

source.description: The one source step. Required. `when:` is not allowed on it.

steps.description: The pipeline's steps, executed strictly in order. Deliver-role adapters are ordinary entries (ADR-031) — any number, any position; there is no top-level deliver block.

group.description: ADR-021: the membership terminus. Records completing the run's final step are `added` to this group (created on demand). Valid with or without deliver steps; captures completers, not sends (ADR-031).

waterfall.description: Reserved (SPEC.md §9). Present only so v1 can add it without a format break; any value here MUST be rejected in v0.

not.description: Reserved on a step too; rejected in v0.

id.description: Step id, unique within the pipeline. Defaults to 'source' / 'step-N'.

use.description: Adapter id, e.g. 'harvest/profile'. Required everywhere except a group source, which declares group: instead.

group.description: ADR-021: group-as-source, valid only on the source step and mutually exclusive with use:. Members are projected from the ledger; provides are open (wildcard), needs enforced per record at run time.

require.description: ADR-021: process only records currently members of EVERY listed group. Valid on any non-source step, deliver steps included. Referenced groups must exist at plan time.

exclude.description: ADR-021: skip records currently members of ANY listed group — the judgment-memory mechanism. Valid on any non-source step, deliver steps included. Referenced groups must exist at plan time.

record.description: ADR-021/031, deliver steps only: the group this step's successful deliveries append `touched` events to. Defaults to the pipeline name per deliver step (steps sharing the default share the scope); created on demand.

suppress.description: ADR-021/031, deliver steps only: skip records with a `touched` event in the group within the window; skips are receipted with reasons and the record advances past the step. Layers above the idempotency floor.

with.description: The step's config, validated against the adapter's config_schema. Sent as OPEN.config. On a human/* step (ADR-049) it MAY carry render: and prompt:, below; engine: is not a key anywhere (ADR-050).

render.description: ADR-049, human/* and agent/* steps: what the participant is shown per record — the listed fields (validated as uses:, SPEC.md §7) or a {{field}} template. Default: the uses: fields, or the of: value alone.

prompt.description: On a human/* step (ADR-049): tty (default) walks the records inside `gtme run` at a terminal, never leaves every record pending for `gtme answer`; an agent/* step is always never. On an ai/* step this is the operator's prompt text (SPEC.md §10.3).

engine.description: Removed (ADR-050): the API is the only model engine and the fixture engine is selected by environment. A step carrying engine: fails `gtme plan` naming the fix; `engine: claude-code` becomes an agent/* step answered through `gtme answer`.

uses.description: ADR-004: a participant step's dynamic needs. Valid only on steps whose adapter role is filter/compose/review (the participant roles, ADR-048: ai/*, human/*, agent/*). The planner MUST validate it exactly as needs.required (SPEC.md §7), and at execution time the projected fields object MUST be built from `uses` rather than from the manifest's open-ended `needs`.

of.description: ADR-048: the referent — the field whose value a compose or review step is about (required on a review; an edit on a compose). Validated exactly as a uses: entry (SPEC.md §7); its current value joins the record's judgment-cache input hash, and its field_values.id is recorded as the referent of everything the step writes.

when.description: Gate. v0 supports only '<step_id>.passed', referencing an earlier step.

cache.description: Freshness-window override for this step, e.g. '30d'.

idempotency.description: Deliver steps only (ADR-031: the planner rejects it elsewhere): the field whose value keys a delivery. Defaults to the identity key (SPEC.md §8); REQUIRED on http/deliver (ADR-023).

variables.description: Deliver steps only (ADR-018/019/031): egress mapping of target merge-field name → canonical or namespaced ledger field. Its values are the step's dynamic needs (SPEC.md §6, §7); the planner validates each against upstream provides and rejects the key on any other step.

redeliver.description: ADR-045, deliver steps only: repeat policy. Defaults to on_change when the adapter declares idempotency: native, never otherwise; always/on_change are plan errors on a target without native idempotency.

on_missing.description: Per-record completeness policy. Deliver steps (ADR-019/031, SPEC.md §8): skip (default) or fail when a variables: target does not resolve to a non-empty value — skip records a verdict and the record advances past the step; fail freezes it; blank merge fields never send, so run is not valid here. Participant steps (ai/*, human/*, agent/*; ADR-053, SPEC.md §7): run (default) dispatches the record with a declared uses: field absent and the receipt counts it; skip advances the record untouched without dispatching; fail fails it naming the missing fields.

provides.description: ADR-033: declared output fields, valid only on participant steps (ai/*, human/*, agent/*; ADR-048). A review MUST declare its labels here. A list of field names, or an object whose keys are field names and whose values are null or declare type, enum, canonical. Bare names land as <pipeline>.<name>; a dotted name is kept as written; canonical: true lands the field on the canonical field of that name (SPEC.md §7).

canonical.description: SPEC.md §7: the declared name IS a canonical field of the pipeline's entity type; the output lands there, global rather than per-campaign.

limit.description: ADR-032: group source only — at most N current members, oldest-added first.

once.description: ADR-052: group source only — select only members this pipeline has not already finished (completed the final step, or stopped by a filter verdict); failed and pending records stay eligible. Oldest-added first within limit. Never mutates the group; a dry or simulated run finishes nothing.

respend.description: ADR-038: declares that re-running the pipeline MAY pay for this step's records again — silences the plan's respend warning (SPEC.md §7). Not valid on the source.
